headers.comment: This is a pitch prototype for a real business. Until NFE approves it and it moves to their own domain, nothing here may be indexed: an indexed draft would compete with nfenterprises.co in search and would publish figures we have not yet verified with them. Note we deliberately do NOT block crawling in robots.txt — a disallowed crawler never fetches the page, so it never sees this header, and the URL can still surface from an inbound link.
